summary: Iteration 4: purge-seed-data guard, backfilled audit entry, and regression. GUARD (never sent PURGE): backend pytest 11/11 pass — POST /api/admin/purge-seed-data returns 401 (no token), 403 (client token even with correct 'PURGE'), 422 for lowercase 'purge', 422 for 'nope', 422 when confirmation field missing. AUDIT: GET /api/admin/erasure-audit (admin) returns exactly 3 rows; exactly one has backfilled=true with anonymized_email=erased-576baf05@anonymized.invalid and a note starting 'BACKFILLED RECORD: erasure actually performed ~2026-08-05 19:50 UTC…'. is_seed_data tagging verified via service key on demo client rows — 0 untagged bookings/deliverables/invoices/retainer_subscriptions rows. REGRESSION (demo client): dashboard shows 2 active bookings, 2 cuts in review, 1 active retainer, 1 open invoice; deliverables page shows 3 cards (Q3 Teaser Cut v2 IN REVIEW, June Social Edit #3 REVISIONS REQUESTED, May Recap Reel FINAL DELIVERED) with BOOKING/RETAINER badges; invoices page shows 2 rows INV-B-3518 (BOOKING, £4,250, SENT) and INV-R-3518 (RETAINER, £3,500, PAID). FRONTEND (admin): /admin renders 3 audit-entry-N; audit-backfilled-badge-0 present on Client B entry with visible italic note text matching backend; Danger zone heading + purge-seed-btn render; clicking purge-seed-btn opens window.prompt — entering wrong text 'purge' and confirming shows toast 'Purge cancelled — confirmation text must be exactly PURGE' AND does NOT delete anything (audit entries reload to 3, backfilled badge count still 1). NO destructive call was ever completed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_purge_seed_data: the 'skipped_admins' filter includes any client with role=='admin' OR id==admin.id, but the SELECT already filters by is_seed_data=true — an admin whose clients row is not is_seed_data (production case) wouldn't even be listed. Current behaviour is safe; consider clarifying comment.

admin_purge_seed_data deletes by is_seed_data=true across 5 tables BEFORE checking per-client invoice remainders. If a seed client somehow had non-seed invoices AND seed invoices, the seed invoices are already gone by the time the per-client 'skipped_clients_with_real_records' check runs. Not a bug for current data (all demo rows are is_seed_data), but the order coupling is fragile. Consider counting non-seed invoices per client BEFORE the bulk table deletes.

The window.prompt-based confirmation on purge-seed-btn is inherently non-styled and can be bypassed by browser preferences; for a truly destructive admin op, a typed-in-modal confirmation (styled Card + Input) would be more robust and testable. Not blocking — the backend guard is the real safeguard.
toast.error 'Purge cancelled …' fires on any non-'PURGE' input INCLUDING null/dismiss — good, but consider distinguishing 'cancelled' vs 'wrong text' for UX.
